text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I have no shell in this session. I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, which matches the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the days late (`days_late + DAILY_FEE`). It now multiplies (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events. It now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`, which also fixes `age()`.

I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
